description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Wattala, Divulapitiya, Kelaniya, Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his/her Office of member
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A (1) (a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of various Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing to be members of the United National Party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which includes matters concerning electoral boundary changes, candidate registrations, and declarations about elected officials.
